prompt: Which movie musical produced a song that was inspired by poetry from an American poet, who was born a week after Queen Victoria?
answer: The movie musical was **_Fame_ (1980)**. Its finale, **“I Sing the Body Electric,”** was inspired by Walt Whitman’s poem of the same name. Whitman was born on **May 31, 1819**, one week after Queen Victoria’s birth.
